home.title: Main Screen
body: The robot dog stands on a platform at the bottom of the pit. Around it are the steps with lessons.
Coins come from chores and tasks. Each income shows where it came from.
Tap «?» on any screen — I will tell you what to do there.

uiKit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.
It helps the team test the UI, and is not part of the game storyline.

ui-kit.title: Developer Screen
body: This is a component showcase: buttons, cards, meters, and sheets in all states.

end-period.title: End the day
body: The day ends only when you press the button — the clock never closes it for you.
If needs are under plan, I give a soft warning. You can still finish.
After you confirm, the totals open: plan next to fact.

period-summary.title: Period totals
body: We compare plan and fact across three directions: needs, wants, savings.
If more went somewhere — those coins did not vanish, they went somewhere else.
Next comes a recovery screen: pick one gentle step for the next period. Progress is never wiped.

recovery.title: Recovery path
body: After the totals you pick one or two concrete steps for the next period.
The options depend on what went off plan — save first, wait on a want, protect needs.
You can skip. Nothing is wiped and nothing is graded.

shop.title: Shop
body: There are four shops: grocery, clothes, decor and toys. Each has its own shelf.
A purchase spends coins and updates the period fact — so the plan can be compared with real life.
If you do not have enough coins, I will say exactly how many are missing and three options: earn, take from the jar, or wait. You cannot go below zero. Toys will get mini-games later.

savings.title: Savings jar
body: There are three goals here. Pick one — it shows on the home screen.
You can put coins in during any active period: they leave the wallet, fill the jar and update the savings fact.
Taking coins out opens a confirm screen: I recalculate how much is left to the goal and roughly how many periods. Not a ban — just the price of the choice.

tasks.title: Tasks
body: Six chores across three themes: planning, savings and payments.
There are quizzes, a shopping basket, need-before-want order, change counting and a dialog — not only tests.
A miss does not wipe progress: the chore still pays part of the coins and names the rule.

history.title: History
body: Finished periods and every coin move with a named source live here.
The last period shows plan next to fact — money did not vanish, it moved.
An empty history is fine at the start; rows appear after the first settlement.

glossary.title: Glossary
body: Short explanations of the game words: plan, fact, needs, wants, savings and more.
Open a term to read a plain-language definition.
The same words show up in hints and on screens so the story stays one piece.

budget-plan.title: Budget plan
body: Split coins across three directions: needs, wants and the jar.
The remainder stays on screen — the plan cannot go below zero.
When you press Confirm, the period goes live and you can spend.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Words of the game, in plain language

plan.title: Plan
plan.definition: First decide where the coins will go, then spend. The plan is three boxes: needs, wants and the jar.

fact.title: Fact
fact.definition: Where the money really went. At the end of a period we compare plan and fact — coins do not vanish, they move.

needs.title: Needs
needs.definition: What you cannot skip: food, soap, the robot's charge. Leave coins for needs first.

wants.title: Wants
wants.definition: Nice-to-haves — a toy, a decoration, extras. Fine to buy after needs and the jar.

savings.title: Savings jar
savings.definition: Coins put aside for a goal. A little each time adds up faster.

goal.title: Goal
goal.definition: One thing you are saving for. You can see how much is in the jar and how much is left.

balance.title: Wallet
balance.definition: How many coins you have now. You cannot go below zero — if short, earn, take from the jar, or wait.

shortfall.title: Shortfall
shortfall.definition: How many coins are missing for a purchase. Not a ban — three ways out: a chore, the jar, or wait.

regularity.title: Regularity
regularity.definition: If you put something in the jar at least once in a period, settlement pays a small bonus — “for putting aside”.

period.title: Period
period.definition: One game loop: make a plan, spend and save, then see the totals. Not a calendar day — a game step.

source.title: Coin source
source.definition: Every credit has a name: starter wallet, chore, bonus. A bare “+18” without a reason never appears.

withdrawal.title: Jar withdrawal
withdrawal.definition: You can take coins back from the jar, but first you see the consequence: the goal moves farther away.

recovery.title: Period {{period}} — next steps
recovery.subtitle: Pick one thing for the next period
recovery.lead: Progress stays. These are gentle next steps — not a grade and not a wipe.

saveFirst.body: Open the plan and set aside savings before wants.

waitOnWant.body: Leave one want for the next period so the jar can grow.

protectNeeds.title: Protect needs in the plan
protectNeeds.body: Give needs enough coins before spending on wants.

keepHabit.title: Keep checking the plan
keepHabit.body: Look at the three boxes before you spend again.

checkPlan.title: Make the next plan carefully
checkPlan.body: Open planning and lay out needs, wants and the jar again.
